1000000.name: Army Camp
1000000.description: Your troops are stationed in Army Camps. Build more camps and upgrade them to muster a powerful army.

1000006.name: Barracks
1000006.description: The Barracks allow you to train troops to attack your enemies. Upgrade the Barracks to unlock advanced units that can win epic battles.

1000070.name: Blacksmith
1000070.description: Bring the right magical ores here and your heroes' equipment can be upgraded to be even mightier! The smoke from the furnace helps make delicious, if unhealthy, brisket.

1000026.name: Dark Barracks
1000026.description: The Dark Barracks will open doors for creatures born out of Dark Elixir. Upgrade the barracks to unlock more troops with unique battle skills.

1000029.name: Dark Spell Factory
1000029.description: Only the most brilliant or reckless Master Wizards dabble in Dark Elixir brewery. Their compact Dark Spells require keen insight to master, but provide unique tactical advantages.

1000071.name: Hero Hall
1000071.description: This fancy Hall honors your Village's mightiest warriors! Visit the Hero Hall for all your heroic essentials, and to upgrade Heroes. Upgrade the Hero Hall to unlock more Heroes!

1000007.name: Laboratory
1000007.description: What dark secrets do these Wizards hide inside their Laboratory? Nobody has dared to look. All we know is that their research makes our spells and troops harder, better, faster and stronger!

1000068.name: Pet House
1000068.description: Every hero deserves a loyal companion. The Pet House allows you to unlock powerful Pets with various abilities to fight alongside your heroes.

1000020.name: Spell Factory
1000020.description: The Spell Factory is home to veteran Wizards who are better suited to creating magical weapons than front-line combat. Use their powerful Attack Spells to turn the tide of a battle in your favor!

1000059.name: Workshop
1000059.description: The Workshop is where Siege Machines are built. Upgrade the Workshop to unlock different Siege Machines!

103000009.name: Air Bombs
103000009.description: Barrel after barrel, Air Bombs blast even the mightiest Flying enemies out of the sky. Your village airspace isn't safe with this Builder Base classic around!

103000013.name: Cake-A-Pult
103000013.description: One splash-damage serving at a time! Cake surrounding enemies in destructive and delectable... cake. When this dessert drops, it leaves an explosive surprise, ensuring no one is around for seconds.

103000012.name: Hero Hunter
103000012.description: Headhunter wants to play a game! This destructive deck dealer targets all troops but serves extra damage to Heroes! Card projectiles cause slowdown and result in poisoned paper cuts.

103000011.name: Hot Candle
103000011.description: The flickering flame of the Hot Candle flings fire spurts at multiple surrounding enemies! Better make your wish quick, as this defense’s target capacity decreases as it melts.

103000010.name: Lava Launcher
103000010.description: A hot delivery From Builder Base. Lava Launcher spits straight fire at a single target from afar! Its piping-hot projectiles play a dangerous game of The Floor is Lava where ground troops always lose.

103000008.name: Roaster
103000008.description: Boils up and blasts hot plasma on ground and air enemies. Give your skin a healthy glow by standing at a safe distance.

1000012.name: Air Defense
1000012.description: This anti-air tower is deadly against flying enemies, but can't target foes on the ground. Place it wisely to cover as much airspace as possible.

1000028.name: Air Sweeper
1000028.description: Air Sweepers control the sky with strong blasts of air that push back flying enemies. Air Sweepers can only face one direction, so rotate them to maximize their effectiveness.

1000009.name: Archer Tower
1000009.description: Archer Towers have longer range than Cannons, and unlike Cannons they can attack flying enemies.

1000032.name: Bomb Tower
1000032.description: Bomb Towers bombard nearby ground troops and go up in a big BOOM when destroyed! Melee units best stand clear!

1000015.name: Builder's Hut
1000015.description: Nothing gets done around here without Builders! You can hire more Builders to start multiple construction projects, or speed up their work by using green gems.

1000008.name: Cannon
1000008.description: Cannons are great for point defense. Upgrade Cannons to increase their firepower, but beware that your Defenses cannot shoot while being upgraded!

1000097.name: Crafting Station
1000097.description: A mysterious machine that can be loaded with one of three powerful crafted defenses. Swap freely between them, then upgrade each one's three modules to make them even stronger!

1000031.name: Eagle Artillery
1000031.description: The Eagle Artillery has nearly unlimited range and targets tough enemies with exploding shells. However, it won't activate until a large amount of troops have been deployed.

1000089.name: Firespitter
1000089.description: The Firespitter spews flames at a fire rate faster than the X-Bow! If it misses, the Firespitter will shoot past its target to deal damage to enemies behind. It can only face a single direction, so place carefully!

1000019.name: Hidden Tesla
1000019.description: Lay a deadly trap with the Hidden Tesla! Our Wizards have trapped a storm cloud into each of these sneaky towers. When an enemy walks or flies close enough, the tower springs up and fries it using the power of Electrickery!

1000027.name: Inferno Tower
1000027.description: Set the Inferno Tower's Dark Elixir fueled flame to build up unbelievable damage to single targets, or to constantly roast multiple targets at once.

1000077.name: Monolith
1000077.description: The Builder's first experiment in using Dark Elixir for a building resulted in something truly frightful. The stronger the Monolith's target, the more damage it does. Great to have defending your Village, but a little scary to attack against.

1000013.name: Mortar
1000013.description: The Mortar can mow down hordes of enemies by the splash damage from its shell. Don't let enemies get too close to it!

1000084.name: Multi-Archer Tower
1000084.description: These Archers have teamed up to take out attackers faster and more furiously than ever. Teamwork makes the dream work!

1000079.name: Multi-Gear Tower
1000079.description: The Multi-Gear Tower is a powerful combination of two classic Defenses! Choose the attack mode that suits you and let the destruction begin! Targets air and ground units.

1000086.name: Revenge Tower
1000086.description: If you destroy its building friends, the Revenge Tower will look for you, it will find you, and it will smite you. As fellow buildings fall, it grows stronger and angrier!

1000085.name: Ricochet Cannon
1000085.description: Builder has used one weird trick to develop a devastating cannonball that will ricochet and hit a second target.

1000067.name: Scattershot
1000067.description: The Scattershot heaves very heavy bundles of poorly tied together rocks at whoever happens to be closest. The bundles break apart on impact and deal additional damage to the troops behind.

1000072.name: Spell Tower
1000072.description: For years, Wizards alone brought magic to the battlefield one fireball at a time. Now they've developed a fully automated way to give your village more ways to mess up attackers with magic!

1000102.name: Super Wizard Tower
1000102.description: Super Wizard's first strike can shock up to fifteen nearby enemies. Chained targets take less damage.

1000011.name: Wizard Tower
1000011.description: The Ultimate Arcane Defense! Tower Wizards cast powerful area effect spells that target both flying and ground troops.

1000021.name: X-Bow
1000021.description: The X-Bow shoots mystical bolts with terrifying power. Load it with Elixir and the X-Bow works automagically. You can set it to target ground units at long ranges, or all targets at reduced range.

107000008.name: Logger
107000008.description: A hardened meteorite hunk with a fascination for forestry. When Logger isn’t petting his mustache woodpeckers, he’s lobbing bouncing logs that push and crush all troop types. The timber may be slow, but it strikes with the full force of nature!

107000000.name: Longshot
107000000.description: Use your head! Longshot fires explosive bolts from her cranium at long range, peppering attackers with delightful dollops of splash damage.

107000001.name: Smasher
107000001.description: This tanky Guardian deals splash damage to ground and air troops. Smasher is a seriously sore loser, raging when the Town Hall is destroyed and leaving rage in his wake when defeated.

90000048.name: Action Figure
90000048.description: Summons Giant Giant to fight by the Archer Queen's side

90000002.name: Archer Puppet
90000002.description: Summons a gang of invisible Archers

90000000.name: Barbarian Puppet
90000000.description: Summons a pack of raged Barbarians

90000035.name: Dark Crown
90000035.description: Boosts health and damage a total of 3 times when allies are defeated

90000043.name: Dark Orb
90000043.description: Damages and slows down everything it touches

90000008.name: Earthquake Boots
90000008.description: Causes a powerful earthquake which destroys Walls and damages Buildings

90000040.name: Electro Boots
90000040.description: Periodically damages everything around the Royal Champion

90000016.name: Electro Fangs
90000016.description: Chomps a chain reaction through buildings surrounding Dragon Duke's target, the electrickery damage decreases by 20% with each chain

90000004.name: Eternal Tome
90000004.description: Grand Warden and all nearby friendly units become immune to damage

90000052.name: Fire Heart
90000052.description: Slowly regenerates health and bursts into damaging Flames when Dragon Duke falls

90000022.name: Fireball
90000022.description: Throws a giant exploding fireball at the closest defense

90000057.name: Flame Blower
90000057.description: Blows scorching fire that damages enemies and buildings

90000050.name: Frost Flake
90000050.description: Flings flakes at the closest Defenses to freeze them

90000015.name: Frozen Arrow
90000015.description: Icy arrows slow down the targets they hit

90000017.name: Giant Arrow
90000017.description: Shoots a giant piercing arrow that crosses the entire village

90000010.name: Giant Gauntlet
90000010.description: Barbarian King becomes gigantic, doing area damage and taking less damage

90000012.name: Haste Vial
90000012.description: Casts Haste on the Royal Champion

90000034.name: Healing Tome
90000034.description: Heals the Grand Warden and all nearby friendly units

90000042.name: Henchmen Puppet
90000042.description: Summons flying bodyguards to support the Minion Prince

90000019.name: Heroic Torch
90000019.description: Gives nearby Troops a burning desire to walk through Walls, move faster, and take less damage

90000009.name: Hog Rider Puppet
90000009.description: Summons a stamede of Hog Riders

90000003.name: Invisibility Vial
90000003.description: Turns the Queen invisible and gives her stronger attacks

90000005.name: Life Gem
90000005.description: Nearby friendly units gain extra hitpoints

90000039.name: Magic Mirror
90000039.description: Summons clones of the Archer Queen

90000044.name: Metal Pants
90000044.description: Creates a protective barrier that blocks almost all damage temporarily

90000049.name: Meteor Staff
90000049.description: Summons mysterious meteors that repeatedly strike the nearest Defense

90000059.name: Monolith Arrow
90000059.description: Monolith Arrow's extra damage decreases when more than 180 and 250 housing spaces of units are deployed

90000047.name: Noble Iron
90000047.description: Increases the speed, range, and power of the Minion Prince's first few attacks

90000061.name: Portal Pendant
90000061.description: Pulls Minion Prince and nearby ally units back to the deployment bar to be summoned elsewhere with extra health and Haste

90000024.name: Rage Gem
90000024.description: Nearby friendly units do extra damage

90000001.name: Rage Vial
90000001.description: Casts Rage on the Barbarian King

90000060.name: Revenge Deck
90000060.description: Defenders who strike Dragon Duke are dealt a painful hand

90000053.name: Rocket Backpack
90000053.description: Dashes across the center of the village breathing Fire and avoiding attacks

90000013.name: Rocket Spear
90000013.description: Her next few spear throws are stronger and longer-ranged

90000007.name: Royal Gem
90000007.description: Heals the Royal Champion by an extra large amount

90000006.name: Seeking Shield
90000006.description: Throws her shield which bounces between defenses, dealing damage

90000032.name: Snake Bracelet
90000032.description: Summons snakes that fight by your side when taking damage

90000014.name: Spiky Ball
90000014.description: Shoots a Spiky Ball which bounces between buildings

90000051.name: Stick Horse
90000051.description: Gallop over walls and get increased movement and attack speed after being deployed

90000056.name: Stun Blaster
90000056.description: Blasts a shockwave that stuns and damages nearby enemies and buildings.

90000011.name: Vampstache
90000011.description: Every time the Barbarian King attacks, he heals himself

28000001.name: Archer Queen
28000001.description: Towering above all other Archers, this graceful huntress is a master of destructive force. Although her health is modest, she snipes targets from afar with her powerful X-bow. As a defender she guards the village with a vengeance.

28000000.name: Barbarian King
28000000.description: Biggest and bravest of all barbarians, this colossal menace soaks up huge amounts of damage and smashes anything in his path with his sword. He guards his territory fiercely when defending.

28000007.name: Dragon Duke
28000007.description: Locked away for his anger issues, this tanky Flying Hero gets madder and mightier when separated from Friendly Flying units. His royal rampage boosts damage by 100%, attack speed by 50%, and reduces damage taken from traps by half. When defending, he can only be attacked by air-targeting enemies.

28000002.name: Grand Warden
28000002.description: This powerful master of magic supports Troops by blasting enemies with his Staff! The Grand Warden can even walk or fly over Walls! He'll make a majestic stand at his Hero Banner when defending.

28000006.name: Minion Prince
28000006.description: The self-proclaimed Prince of Darkness means business! The Minion Prince takes to the skies and damages targets with dark magic! When defending, he can only be attacked by ranged and air units.

28000004.name: Royal Champion
28000004.description: Over the Wall and at them! The Royal Champion is only afraid of four things, and the enemy isn't one of them. Her short range is perfect for stabbing defenses up close and personal.

1000064.name: B.O.B's Hut
1000064.description: B.O.B, a totally normal Builder, lives here among us. Definitely not a robot controlled from the Builder Base.

73000011.name: Angry Jelly
73000011.description: This blob of pure anger gets impatient waiting around the Village, it's hungry for a good fight. During Battle it convinces its Hero to attack Defenses before splitting to fight separately.

73000008.name: Diggy
73000008.description: Diggy is an introvert and spends a lot of time hiding underground. Still when it comes to battle, he'll do his part, coming up to attack buildings and aid his Hero. If his Hero's taken out, he'll seek out a new one for support, scritches.

73000002.name: Electro Owl
73000002.description: Electro Owl zaps enemy defenses into dust from great distance. He's mostly made of feathers though, so better keep him well protected!

73000009.name: Frosty
73000009.description: Frosty is the coolest pet... literally. Not only does his icy breath cause enemies to chill out, but he also releases swarms of Frostmites to further slow down defenses and help his Hero.

73000017.name: Greedy Raven
73000017.description: No scarecrow is frightning enough to keep Greedy Raven away from shiny loot! This masked bandit's swift feathers target and deal extra damage to resource buildings and egos.

73000000.name: L.A.S.S.I
73000000.description: The trustiest hound to ever roam the village proper, L.A.S.S.I chases enemies with unrelenting fury. Unless they fly, in which case she just observes them intently.

73000001.name: Mighty Yak
73000001.description: Built like a Siege Machine, the Mighty Yak has a knack for knocking down Walls it comes in contact with. It also flies into a rage if you knock out its companion.

73000004.name: Phoenix
73000004.description: A true friend will egg you on when things get rough. Phoenix starts the battle as a helpless egg, but at the moment her Hero might go down, she hatches. The furious fiery fowl then gives temporary invulnerability to its Hero and engages nearby enemies.

73000007.name: Poison Lizard
73000007.description: Always the fastest never the lastest, Poison Lizard spits slowing toxins at its foes. Is it actually a venom lizard? Possibly, but who's brave enough to correct it?

73000016.name: Sneezy
73000016.description: Her nose is blocked and loaded! Sneezy hangs behind her Hero due to allergies and sneezes tanky air Boogers that target Buildings. She goes on attack when her Hero falls!

73000010.name: Spirit Fox
73000010.description: An extremely shy creature, who's happiest alone in the woods outside the Village. When called to battle, Spirit Fox fights fiercely alongside their hero and helps them with a little invisibility.

73000003.name: Unicorn
73000003.description: Unicorns have severe trust issues, but overcoming them with love and patience is totally worth it. They'll heal up any minor or major scrapes as well as any Healer!

1000014.name: Clan Castle
1000014.description: The Clan Castle houses your Treasury and any reinforcement troops or spells sent by your clanmates.

1000023.name: Dark Elixir Drill
1000023.description: Our Builders have finally figured a way to extract pure Dark Elixir, the rarest form of the magical substance.

1000024.name: Dark Elixir Storage
1000024.description: The power of Dark Elixir could not be contained in a regularly shaped Elixir vat. As it's three times as powerful, we had to invent a cubical form of storage!

1000002.name: Elixir Collector
1000002.description: Elixir is pumped from the Ley Lines coursing underneath your village. Upgrade your Elixir Collectors to maximize Elixir production.

1000003.name: Elixir Storage
1000003.description: These storages contain the elixir pumped from underground. Upgrade them to increase the maximum amount of elixir you can store.

1000004.name: Gold Mine
1000004.description: The Gold Mine produces gold. Upgrade it to boost its production and gold storage capacity.

1000005.name: Gold Storage
1000005.description: All your precious gold is stored here. Don't let sneaky goblins anywhere near! Upgrade the storage to increase its capacity and durability against attack.

4000052.name: Battle Blimp
4000052.description: The Battle Blimp bypasses ground-based obstacles and delivers your Clan Castle troops directly into the heart of the enemy village, all while dropping bombs along the way. However, its thin hide makes it easier to shoot down. Immune to spell effects.

4000092.name: Battle Drill
4000092.description: A fine example of goblin ingenuity, the Battle Drill burrows underground towards the nearest defense. On arrival it pops up to stun and demolish with its dastardly drill.

4000091.name: Flame Flinger
4000091.description: This little charmer flings bundles of Fire Spirits that both hit hard and leave behind a burning mess. Its long range helps it stay out of trouble, but beware of longer range defenses and traps! Immune to spell effects.

4000087.name: Log Launcher
4000087.description: While the Log Launcher certainly isn't the fastest or the sturdiest, it is definitely among the meanest. The trunk-throwing contraption pummels everything in front of it with endless logs to open up a path to the enemy Town Hall. Immune to spell effects.

4000075.name: Siege Barracks
4000075.description: The Siege Barracks parachutes down gracefully to first release a menagerie of P.E.K.K.As and Wizards and then the Clan Castle troops. How they all managed to squeeze inside is a mystery not really worth investigating.

4000188.name: Sky Wagon
4000188.description: Tell walls to take a hike and drop troops from above. Sky Wagon delivery services are fast, reliable and destructive! Though its wooden body can't withstand a lot of damage, its mastery of the skies and immunity to spells more than make up for it.

4000062.name: Stone Slammer
4000062.description: The Stone Slammer is a heavy-duty, flying mountain that targets defensive buildings by flattening them with giant boulders and causes earthquakes. Immune to spell effects.

4000135.name: Troop Launcher
4000135.description: This immobile machine launches barrel loads of Troops and Clan Castle Troops at your allies in battle to support them. Each barrel can hold multiple Troops, including one Clan Castle Troop. There's only a few barrels inside, so make them count!

4000051.name: Wall Wrecker
4000051.description: The Wall Wrecker exists for two simple purposes: smash through anything that it comes across and deliver the Clan Castle troops straight to the heart of the village. Built from heavy-duty materials, it can take a pummeling before breaking down. Immune to spell effects.

26000123.name: Angry Spell
26000123.description: Distilled from the jelly of the Pet House's grumpiest resident, the Angry Spell infuriates troops within its ironically sweet-smelling radius, making them target defenses temporarily..

26000028.name: Bat Spell
26000028.description: Summon an army of Bats anywhere on the battlefield! Deploy aerial reinforcements wherever you need them most. Bats do not trigger Traps.

26000016.name: Clone Spell
26000016.description: Turn this Spell into a pop-up army! Clone Spells create a circle of spawning that creates limited-lifetime copies of troops that enter it. It will only spawn up to a maximum housing space of troops.

26000010.name: Earthquake Spell
26000010.description: Weaken Walls and buildings with crippling earthquakes! Earthquake Spells damage structures based on their maximum hitpoints. Repeated Earthquakes deal decreasing damage to the same buildings, but increasing damage to the same Walls. No Wall can withstand the might of four Earthquake Spells!

26000005.name: Freeze Spell
26000005.description: When the going gets hot, stay frosty! The Freeze Spell sends out a cryogenic blast that temporarily immobilizes enemy troops and disables defensive buildings within its radius.

26000011.name: Haste Spell
26000011.description: Put some hustle in even your heaviest units! Haste Spells lack the damage boost of Rage Spells, but provide an even better boost to movement speed. A lower storage space also allows you to take more of them into battle!

26000001.name: Healing Spell
26000001.description: Heal your Troops to keep them in the fight! Cast this spell to create a Ring of Healing. Your units will be healed while they are inside this ring.

26000109.name: Ice Block Spell
26000109.description: Cast this cool concoction to encase your ground and air Troops in ice that blocks almost all damage but Freezes their movement and attack!

26000035.name: Invisibility Spell
26000035.description: Invisibility Spell makes EVERYTHING except for Walls and Siege Machines invisible and untargetable within its radius.

26000003.name: Jump Spell
26000003.description: Walls slowing you down? Try making a shortcut! Cast this spell near enemy walls to create a route straight over them. Your troops will jump over affected walls pieces as if they weren't even there!

26000000.name: Lightning Spell
26000000.description: Electrocute your enemies with a bolt of lightning! Cast this spell at the enemy village to damage and stun buildings and units inside a small area.

26000070.name: Overgrowth Spell
26000070.description: Ever wish you could ignore a whole chunk of that enemy base? The Overgrowth Spell traps nearby Buildings in tough roots, stopping Defenses attacking. Troops ignore trapped Buildings.

26000009.name: Poison Spell
26000009.description: Give your army the upper hand against enemy troops with this deadly poison! Defending units that linger in a Poison Spell's toxic cloud will move slower, attack slower and take damage with increasing severity over time. Poison Spells do not affect structures.

26000002.name: Rage Spell
26000002.description: Enrage your units to make them bigger, faster and stronger! Cast this to create a Ring of Rage! Your units will gain speed and attack power while they are inside this ring.

26000053.name: Recall Spell
26000053.description: Attack going badly? Need to come in from another direction? The Recall Spell summons back Troops, Heroes and Pets to the deployment bar. You can then send the recalled units back out for a second strike.

26000098.name: Revive Spell
26000098.description: The Healer's own special recipe! The Revive Spell brings a defeated Hero in its range back into the fight with some health. Bring this Spell into battle, and a floating golden heart will appear above any defeated Hero that can be revived. Upgrade the Revive Spell to increase the amount of health Heroes regain.

26000017.name: Skeleton Spell
26000017.description: Summon an army of Skeletons anywhere on the battlefield! Put a few extra swords when and where you need them most. Skeletons do not trigger traps.

26000120.name: Totem Spell
26000120.description: Hey, look over there! Distract ground and air Defenses by dropping a Totem Spell. Nearby enemies will focus their attack on the Totem, taking the heat off other troops. Forged from dense cosmic rock, the Totem also damages and stuns the area in which it lands.

1000001.name: Town Hall
1000001.description: This is the heart of your village. Upgrading the Town Hall unlocks new defenses, buildings, traps and much more.

12000005.name: Air Bomb
12000005.description: Latest invention in the field of flying pest control. This trap can blast multiple air units in a small area.

12000000.name: Bomb
12000000.description: Bombs are traps that remain hidden until activated by an attacking troop moving into their trigger radius. Once triggered, they must be re-armed for free.

12000002.name: Giant Bomb
12000002.description: When you're looking for a Big Boom, you need the Giant Bomb. A much more powerful version of the Bomb that deals heavy splash damage to all nearby ground troops.

12000020.name: Giga Bomb
12000020.description: Villagers didn't want to keep this dangerous Weapon inside the Town Hall, so they moved it out! The Giga Bomb pushes enemies back with massive damage. This Trap is so deadly, it doesn't need to hide!

12000006.name: Seeking Air Mine
12000006.description: Is it a bird? Is it a plane? Well, it makes no difference as the Seeking Air Mine will blow it sky high. This trap does devastating damage to a single air unit.

12000008.name: Skeleton Trap
12000008.description: Ambush and distract unsuspecting foes with a surprise skirmish of short-lived, but sneaky skeleton troops! Skeleton Traps can be configured to pursue ground or air troops.

12000001.name: Spring Trap
12000001.description: Bounces enemy ground units off the battlefield. Units within its spring capacity are ejected instantly. Units exceeding capacity are launched but take damage instead.

12000016.name: Tornado Trap
12000016.description: Wind and stones may break some bones, but this trap will definitely confound you. Just place one of these traps down and the released vortex will draw the enemy troops in, hindering their progress.

4000097.name: Apprentice Warden
4000097.description: Despite his grand ambitions, Apprentice Warden is still just a student. Supports troops with his magical Life Aura and less-magical slingshot.

4000001.name: Archer
4000001.description: These sharpshooters like to keep their distance on the battlefield and in life. Nothing makes them happier than single-mindedly taking down their target.

4000023.name: Baby Dragon
4000023.description: This fire-breathing hatchling is shy around other air units, but leave it alone and it'll throw a fit! When not around other air units, Baby Dragons become enraged and gain bonus damage and attack speed.

4000005.name: Balloon
4000005.description: These promoted skeletons have traded in their joy of destroying walls for a joy of destroying defenses. Deploy them to take out pesky mortars and cannons!

4000000.name: Barbarian
4000000.description: This fearless warrior relies on his bulging muscles and striking mustache to wreak havoc in enemy villages. Release a horde of Barbarians and enjoy the mayhem!

4000022.name: Bowler
4000022.description: This big blue dude digs the simple things in life - Dark Elixir drinks and throwing rocks. His massive boulders bounce off of their target and hit again behind it for a double strike!

4000065.name: Dragon Rider
4000065.description: This aerial engine of destruction readily and frankly, quite excitedly lays waste to any defense it comes across. The skeleton onboard swears he's not touching the controls.

4000008.name: Dragon
4000008.description: The might of the dragons is known throughout the land. This scaly terror of the skies feels no mercy and nothing will escape the fiery splashes of his breath.

4000123.name: Druid
4000123.description: The Druid has complicated emotions. One moment he's calmly helping heal his fellow Troops, and the next he's turned into a very angry Bear.

4000059.name: Electro Dragon
4000059.description: Possessing iron-tough scales and a breath of devastating lightning, the Electro Dragon's favorite thing is raining destruction from above. When vanquished, the Electro Dragon even pummels the ground with lightning strikes! (6 lightning bolts on death, each dealing the listed death damage to a random target.)

4000095.name: Electro Titan
4000095.description: Barely controlling her raw magical power, the Electro Titan is a formidable force on the battlefield. She channels some of her magic into a powerful electro whip while the rest spills out to damage everything around her.

4000150.name: Furnace
4000150.description: The Furnace doesn't move, but it does spawn Firemites over time that target Buildings. These curious little guys leave pools of fire where they visit!

4000003.name: Giant
4000003.description: These big guys may seem calm, but show them a Cannon or Archer Tower and you'll see their fury unleashed! Slow yet durable, these warriors are best used to soak up hits.

4000002.name: Goblin
4000002.description: These pesky little creatures only have eyes for one thing: LOOT! They are faster than a Spring Trap, and their hunger for resources is limitless.

4000013.name: Golem
4000013.description: The mighty Golem loves to soak up damage! When destroyed, it explodes and splits into Golemites. The resulting Golemites have one-fifth the Golem's strength and hitpoints.

4000082.name: Headhunter
4000082.description: Headhunter has just one job: taking out enemy heroes. As her other job, she works at the village apothecary. She's lightweight enough to jump over walls and her poisoned weapons make her targets move and attack slower.

4000011.name: Hog Rider
4000011.description: Having tamed the fierce leaping hog, the Hog Rider punishes those who hide behind their puny walls! Fueled by Dark Elixir, these warriors have never known defeat!

4000058.name: Ice Golem
4000058.description: The Ice Golem has a chilling personality and absolutely zero sense of humour. He frosts over everything he touches, freezes his surroundings when destroyed and ices up when talked to at a party. On defense his freeze effect is smaller and has a shorter duration.

4000177.name: Meteor Golem
4000177.description: From the cosmos, to your army! This lob-loving duo will throw themselves at anything for up-close damage. When separated, Meteormites will attack nearby targets or find a friend to form a Meteor Golem!

4000024.name: Miner
4000024.description: He digs underground, passing through Walls to attack your target buildings!

4000010.name: Minion
4000010.description: This terror of the skies was born out of Dark Elixir. Undetectable by the Seeking Air Mine, Minions materialize with ease, but are fragile in our world.

4000009.name: P.E.K.K.A
4000009.description: Is P.E.K.K.A a knight? A samurai? A robot? No one knows! P.E.K.K.A's armor absorbs even the mightiest of blows.

4000110.name: Root Rider
4000110.description: This earth warrior is so in tune with nature she doesn't need to walk herself. Riding into battle atop a tough tree root, Root Rider can smash through Walls and slam Defenses into dust.

4000109.name: Ruin Witch
4000109.description: After Ruin Witch lost her powers in an unusual alchemy accident, Master Builder crafted an ingenious invention to keep her summoning pursuits alive. The Debrisbuster 5000 vacuums the remains of fallen buildings and spits out battle-ready Ruin Knights.

4000132.name: Thrower
4000132.description: This powerful pitcher has his eye on the prize! The Thrower hurls mighty spears from long range at enemies and Defenses. His secret? The strength lies in his fabulous facial hair!

4000012.name: Valkyrie
4000012.description: A master of the two-handed axe, this glorious warrior runs between nearby buildings and can shred several troops or buildings at once with her whirlwind blow!

4000004.name: Wall Breaker
4000004.description: Nothing warms a Wall Breaker's cold and undead heart like blowing up walls. A squad of them will make way for your ground units, and they will do it with a BANG!

4000015.name: Witch
4000015.description: The Witch never fights alone, constantly raising dead warriors from past battles to lead her attacks. Upgraded Witches raise more skeletons at a time.

4000006.name: Wizard
4000006.description: The Wizard is a terrifying presence on the battlefield. Pair him up with some of his fellows and cast concentrated blasts of destruction on anything, land or sky!

4000053.name: Yeti
4000053.description: The heavy-hitting furry fellow digs cold weather and his Yetimite buddies. Hurt him, and you'll make the Yetimites real angry.

1000010.name: Wall
1000010.description: Walls are great for keeping your village safe and your enemies in the line of fire.
